collection.title: Citroen C1 2005 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C1 2005 to 2014 model requires a 26" wiper blade and the following blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have rear wiper blades for this C1, click the Rear Blades tab below to view them.
